title: taskAuditRecord
responsibility: Persists a content-addressed audit of the task, source revision, individual checks and remaining semantic limitation.

inputs.name: taskAuditRecord.root
inputs.description: Project filesystem root used to read committed source, loop metadata or verification evidence.

inputs.name: taskAuditRecord.input
inputs.type: TaskAuditInput & { commit: string | null; checks: TaskCheck[] }
inputs.description: Declared task, exact or unavailable commit, and the actual individual check outcomes to persist.

outputs.name: taskAuditRecord
outputs.description: Content-addressed audit stored under the repository Git path or a project-isolated temporary fallback.
